body: Merged main to resolve conflicts (.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md: keep both sides). Targeted gate: green (0 steps, docs/process only). Ready for a re-check (/resolve-conflicts check).

**Needs changes before merge.**

Thank you for this row. The text is clear, and it is the text that issue #2885 asks for. One problem holds the merge: the row documents behaviour that is not on `main`.

### What looks good

- The PR changes one file: `.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md`, one added line. The row is directly after "2D Pocket rest machining (#1489)", as the issue asks.
- The PR does not edit `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION`. The body has `Process change: yes`, a `Changelog: none` line, and ends with `Fixes #2885`.
- The commit subject is a conventional commit (`docs(mcp): ...`).
- I compared the row with the head of PR #2890 (`3914606bf`). The row agrees with that branch: `RestSourceDto::PreviousOperations` (`"previous_operations"`) in `crates/app/src/project/rest_dto.rs`, and the `entered_tool`, Trochoidal, arc-turn and tilt refusals in `crates/app/src/operation/rest_op.rs`.

### Results merged with main (locally)

- Trial merge of the head with `upstream/main` (`d66400b78`): clean. The merged diff is the one line in the skill file.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main --dry-run`: not complete. The xtask build went past the time limit of this review, and the run printed no plan. The diff changes no file in `crates/` or `xtask/`, so no test binary maps to it.
- No build, test or clippy run. This diff changes no code.
- Extra suites run: none. The diff changes no file under `testdata/` and no importer code.
- Safety tier: no. The diff does not change posted G-code, a gouge or collision check, stock simulation or geometry. It changes no UI.

### Requested before merge

1. `.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md:158` - the row documents 2D Adaptive rest machining from the previous operations. That feature is in PR #2890 (#1446). PR #2890 is open, a draft, labelled `needs-rework` and `conflicts`, and it is a `feat` that merges at the next cut. On `upstream/main` the key `previous_operations` and the 2D Adaptive rest refusals do not exist (`git grep previous_operations upstream/main -- crates` finds nothing). If this PR merges first, the skill tells MCP agents to use a parameter that `main` does not have. `P5` work follows what shipped (AGENTS.md, Issue Law, the `P5` row).
   Do one of these:
   - Hold this PR until PR #2890 merges. Then merge `main` into this branch and compare the row with the merged code again, because the rework of PR #2890 can change the refusals.
   - Or stack the change on PR #2890 (AGENTS.md "Overlapping issues stack"): base it on `issue/1446-rest-adaptive-op` and write "stacked on #2890" in the body.

### Notes (not blocking)

- Issue #2885 also says that PR #2822 (#2033) owes the same file a row for the `source` key of the 2D Pocket. The PR #2890 branch also contains `docs/decisions/2033-rest-previous-ops.md`. When the feature merges, one edit can add the two rows. This PR does not have to do that.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
Agreed, holding this PR as a draft until PR #2890 merges into main. Once #2890 lands, I will merge main, verify the refusal wording against the final code, and mark the PR ready for review.

Thank you @JSwetz - your row is now in #2890 (commit `3fa4fd09e`, with you as the commit author), so it ships together with the 2D Adaptive rest feature it documents, instead of waiting here for #2890 to merge first. #2890 now closes #2885 too. Closed as folded in; nothing is lost, and you keep the credit in the history.
